items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 8 at 4:53PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Yukon Flats

The Yukon River breakup front was 28 miles downstream of Fort Yukon
on Thursday afternoon.  Several large ice runs from the ice jams
below Dawson have cleared Eagle and will be making their way past
Circle and Ft. Yukon today and tomorrow.  Water level rises are
expected with these ice runs, but no flooding.

items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 7 at 5:38PM AKDT until May 10 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues.

* WHERE...Draanjik River near Chalkyitsik.

* WHEN...Until noon AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...There is a 10 mile long ice jam that starts several
bends below Chalkyitsik and looks like it will remain in place for
at least a few days. The upstream areas appear mostly ice free so
no further ice should accumulate on the jam. However, water levels
will likely continue to slowly rise until the jam releases.
